description: This file implements an event-driven programming library, including event loop creation, file event management, time event scheduling, and multiplexing layer integration, used for asynchronous I/O operations.

methods.name: aeCreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new event loop with a specified size.

methods.name: aeGetSetSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the event set.

methods.name: aeResizeSetSize
methods.description: Resizes the event set, reallocating internal structures.

methods.name: aeDeleteEventLoop
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the event loop.

methods.name: aeCreateFileEvent
methods.description: Registers a file descriptor with specified event mask and callback.

methods.name: aeDeleteFileEvent
methods.description: Removes specified event mask from a file descriptor.

methods.name: aeGetFileEvents
methods.description: Returns the current event mask for a file descriptor.

methods.name: aeCreateTimeEvent
methods.description: Schedules a new time event after a specified delay.

methods.name: aeDeleteTimeEvent
methods.description: Deletes a scheduled time event by ID.

methods.name: aeProcessEvents
methods.description: Processes pending file and time events based on flags.

methods.name: aeWait
methods.description: Waits for a file descriptor to become ready within a timeout.

methods.name: aeMain
methods.description: Runs the event loop until stopped.

methods.name: aeGetApiName
methods.description: Returns the name of the multiplexing API in use.

methods.name: aeSetBeforeSleepProc
methods.description: Sets a callback to be called before sleeping in the event loop.

methods.name: aeSetAfterSleepProc
methods.description: Sets a callback to be called after waking up in the event loop.
